commonDependencyDisclosure: Both pipeline arms used the same custom Ceres build and repaired PoseLib; this is not a comparison of complete stock versus custom stacks.

sourceLineage.candidateComposition: Pinned composition including an unmerged maintainer LoMa overlay and 13-file robustness overlay; retained objects have their recorded provenance limits.
sourceLineage.poseLibRepair: One-object repair corresponding to official merged PR214; unaffected archive members and consumer coverage checked.

ceresBalanced.processTimingScope: GNU time, 0.01-second resolution; model load, solve and output writing

currentConsumerQualification.pythonSupportClosure: Private explicit support closure: five pinned pure-Python wheels, qualified filtered OpenCV4.13.0, and a one-translation-unit pyceres2.6 build using matching pybind3.1/v12 and Ceres ABI; private explicit tuple-return annotation for new pybind typed tuples. Not a stock environment or dependency/provider replacement.

privacyAndScope: No image filenames, absolute paths, process or booking identifiers, private model identifiers, or raw traces are included. Measurements describe a small single-scene screen; no accuracy winner or general default adoption is established.

windowsSupportedFallback.evidence: reported remote qualification; remote payloads not independently rehashed here

geometryAgreement.reference: first upstream run at each image limit; camera-center Sim3, no ICP, 100000 deterministic vertex-to-triangle queries per direction

activationAndDefaults.sparseImplementationBuildBoundary: non-HIP CUDA >=13.2, plus support/provenance/budget admission checks; older CUDA has explicit unsupported fallback
activationAndDefaults.ceresDefinitionMeaning: These are compiler definitions, not named upstream CMake options. Build enablement does not prove admission in every solve.

pipelineSparseActivationScope: Saved PatchMatch native logs: candidate recorded four five-reference sparse-alias batch executions per run,16across four candidate runs; pool creation and execution counted separately. No inference that every reference or Ceres solve uses these paths.
publicProjection: Detailed machine telemetry and local binary fingerprints omitted; numerical results, source revisions, build settings and collection limits retained.
